scope: one matched single-host loopback run per option, 40 input tokens and one generated token, request-sized cold prepared inventory, W8A8 CPU
command: uv run --no-sync pllm benchmark run --experiment examples/benchmarks/client_prefix_layers.py:baseline --experiment examples/benchmarks/client_prefix_layers.py:prefix_one --experiment examples/benchmarks/client_prefix_layers.py:prefix_two --max-output-tokens 1 --warmups 0 --repetitions 1 --trust-python --prompt 'Explain why a short private prompt should remain private.' --inventory-policy request-sized --format json --output /tmp/client-prefix-cohort.json
limitations: Covered application bodies only, not HTTP/TLS or checkpoint distribution. One sample per candidate cannot establish latency/CPU trends or model quality. Provider checkpoint storage is unchanged, and client weight download/storage increases with local layers.
